candidates.explanation: The size check uses `<` instead of `>`. It throws 413 'File too large' when fileSize is below maxFileSize, so a 200 KB file is rejected. Files at or above the limit, such as 20 MB, pass the check and get a signed URL. The comparison is inverted, so the limit is never enforced.

fix.description: Invert the comparison so it throws only when the size exceeds the limit: `file.fileSize > maxFileSize`. Also, `|| 0` makes any file too large when maxFileSize is unset. Skip the check or use a sane default in that case.
